Djezzy poursuit sa dynamique de croissan: Djezzy continues its growth momentum in the first half of 2026
Djezzy annonce des résultats en progress: Djezzy announces improved results for the first half of 2026, confirming the company's growth dynamic, driven by the evolution of its main financial and operational indicators.
Au cours des six premiers mois de l’anné: During the first six months of 2026, Djezzy achieved a turnover of 62.2 billion dinars, up 8.7% compared to the same period in 2025.
La base clients a également progressé po: The customer base also increased to reach 18.1 million subscribers at the end of June 2026, representing growth of 4.2% year-on-year. This development reflects customer confidence and the relevance of the offers offered.
Sur le plan financier, l’EBITDA s’est ét: Financially, EBITDA stood at 26.7 billion dinars, up 6.6% compared to the same period in 2025. The EBITDA margin remained above 40%, confirming the good operational control of the company.
Commentant ces résultats, Boumediene Sen: Commenting on these results, Boumediene Senouci, Managing Director of Djezzy, said:
« Les résultats du premier semestre 2026: “The results for the first half of 2026 are in line with the trajectory defined by our annual roadmap and demonstrate the progression of our performance as well as the renewed confidence of our shareholders and that of our customers. We remain committed to providing quality services and developing innovative solutions that meet the needs of our customers and partners”
